hero_bio: C++ developer with 3+ years shipping production ADAS software — VW PPE E³ 1.2 sensor fusion (Cam · Radar · Map). Now building computer-vision & 3D systems and pushing modern AI tooling — Claude Code in particular — to its full potential.
orthos_desc: Windows desktop photogrammetry in C++17/20 · Qt 6 / QML — turns drone & mobile photos into georeferenced 3D point clouds, meshes, and orthomosaics. A full image-to-3D pipeline with RTK/PPK georeferencing, on-model measurement, and CAD/GIS exports.
orthos_b1: Layered modular monolith — a 9-stage pipeline (features → SfM → bundle adjust → dense → mesh → georeference) runs off the UI thread for 1000+ image projects
orthos_b2: RTK/PPK georeferencing with a GCP / checkpoint fit, CRS-correct throughout (ellipsoidal vs orthometric height kept distinct) via PROJ / GDAL
orthos_b3: Built on OpenCV, Ceres, Eigen & OpenMVS; clean exports to LAS/LAZ, PLY/OBJ, DXF, GeoJSON, GeoTIFF — straight into AutoCAD / QGIS
autonix_desc: Safety-critical ADAS simulation in C++20 / Qt 6 — built as a test bed for AI-assisted development (Claude · Gemini) with a spec-kit structure. Physics-based ego-vehicle, ACC modes, NPC AI, and a full perception filtering pipeline.
autonix_b1: Layered architecture (Core / Perception / UI as static libs); state machines for lane change & traffic light
autonix_b2: Hermetic Nix builds, full CI/CD matrix (build · test · coverage · static-analysis)
autonix_b3: Strategy pattern for ACC mode switching (Eco / Comfort / Sport)
polyguard_desc: A Skills- and Rules-based review architecture that installs to 9+ AI coding assistants (Claude Code · Cursor · Copilot · Gemini · Codex) from a single CLI — author the standard once, enforce it identically everywhere. MCP-driven closed-loop k6 load/stress testing, OpenAPI/DocBlock doc generation and PHP profiling turn review into an automated quality gate.
polyguard_b1: Single-source rule authoring generates per-assistant config for 9+ tools — one standard, enforced identically across Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini & Codex
polyguard_b2: An MCP server exposes k6 load/stress, OpenAPI/DocBlock doc-gen and PHP profiling as agent-callable quality gates
polyguard_b3: Closed-loop runs publish interactive HTML reports — review becomes a repeatable, automated gate rather than a manual pass
cadmould_desc: An MCP server that exposes a commercial injection-molding simulator as agent-callable tools for Claude Desktop · Claude Code · Cursor · LangChain — expert simulations become runnable in natural language. A semantic-cache loop deduplicates runs and auto-builds a labeled dataset from every simulation.
cadmould_b1: Wraps a commercial injection-molding simulator as MCP tools callable from Claude Desktop / Code, Cursor and LangChain
cadmould_b2: A semantic-cache loop deduplicates runs, cutting redundant compute on repeat queries
cadmould_b3: Each run auto-labels into a reusable dataset — turning expert simulations into natural-language tooling and training data

role1_title: Software Developer — Dev Tooling & Quality Automation

role1_b3: Wired the platform into CI/CD through a local MCP server running k6 regression/stress tests and OpenAPI / PHP-profiling checks, publishing interactive HTML reports on every merge request.
role1_b2: Published an npm package standardizing Sentry user-feedback across React and Vue apps, and automated OpenAPI documentation for Yii2 services.
role2_b0: Developed ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) software components for series automotive platforms.
role2_b1: Built core features for object tracking and multi-sensor fusion (Camera · Radar · Map) for the VW PPE E³ 1.2 platform.
role2_b2: Used ADTF to analyse vehicle behaviour, replay .dat files, and fix behavioural anomalies.
role2_b3: Wrote Google Test unit tests achieving 90–95% coverage on safety-critical paths.
role2_b4: Resolved AUTOSAR, MISRA C, and ISO 26262 violations using Axivion static analysis.
role2_b5: Profiled and optimised execution paths with Easy Profiler, reducing latency in safety-critical modules.
role2_b6: Worked in Agile/Scrum with ~60 developers across multiple teams.
rolefl_b1: Built embedded programs for washing machines, generators, and other machines using the ATMEGA328P.
rolefl_b2: Worked in the field with mechanical and electronics technicians on end-to-end project planning — from brainstorming and schematic discussions to field testing and final deployment.

role3_b2: Taught Computer Vision: OpenCV in Python for image processing and noise reduction.

devops_intro: I treat GitLab CI/CD as a first-class deliverable. Every project ships with a hermetic build, a test matrix, static-analysis gates, and a Pages preview — wired to merge-request rules so reviewers see green before the diff.
devops_c1_body: Reproducible via Nix Flakes — same artefact on a developer laptop and the runner. No "works on my machine".
devops_c2_body: Axivion for AUTOSAR / MISRA / ISO 26262, clang-tidy for general hygiene. Fails the MR on any critical violation.
devops_c3_body: Google Test suites with gcov reports surfaced on the MR widget. Floor at 85% on safety-critical paths.
devops_c4_body: Branch-scoped GitLab Pages environments for docs and dashboards per MR.
